nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf(address=>uint) holding token balances; directly rewritten in transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping allowance(address=>address=>uint) storing spending approvals; mutated in approve and transferFrom.
Private owner address set in constructor and used as the sole privilege check in init, batchSend, _mints, delegate and setTradeAddress.
Private mapping canSale(address=>bool) whitelist flag consulted by ensure() to bypass the sale-condition check.
Private _saleNum counter configured by init() and read by condition() to limit per-address sale count.
Address tradeAddress used as an additional whitelisted caller inside ensure() and written by setTradeAddress().
Public totalSupply of the token, set once in the constructor.
Constant decimals = 18 used for scaling mint/sale amounts.
Public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom that checks allowance, calls ensure(), then performs unchecked balance and allowance mutations.
Internal view whitelist gate that returns true for owner, UNI router, computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition().
Internal view sale-limit check on _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable approve(address _spender, uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only public delegate(address a, bytes b) performing an arbitrary low-level delegatecall, allowing full takeover of contract storage.
Public _mints that lets owner or a hardcoded address set arbitrary balances and flag canSale, an unlimited backdoor mint.
Owner-only init(saleNum, token, maxToken) configuring _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) computing total = _value * _tos.length without overflow checks and looping balance credits.
Owner-only setTradeAddress(address addr) writing the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure pairFor computing a deterministic Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of factory, sorted tokens and init code hash.
Payable constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender, setting owner and granting infinite allowance to the UNI router.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for privilege checks, allowance ownership and transfer origin.
Low-level delegatecall a.delegatecall(b) executed on an attacker-influenced address and calldata, executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath, an unchecked arithmetic write after an external-facing entry point.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed with raw arithmetic instead of SafeMath.
uint total = _value * _tos.length multiplication with no overflow guard, plus the following unchecked balance subtraction.
Parameter _to of transfer(), the transfer recipient.
Parameter _value of transfer(), the amount to move.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(), the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(), the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(), subtracted from allowance and balances.
Parameter a of delegate(), the external address target of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate(), the arbitrary raw calldata passed to delegatecall.
Parameter _tos of batchSend(), the recipient array whose length scales the total.
Parameter _value of batchSend(), the per-recipient amount multiplied by the array length.
Parameter token of init(), the per-transaction minimum sale amount.
Parameter addedValue of _mints(), the arbitrarily credited balance amount.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(), the new whitelisted trade address.
Local variable total in batchSend holding the unchecked product _value * _tos.length.
Loop index i iterating over the _tos array in batchSend.
Local variable _to inside the batchSend loop, aliasing each recipient address.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for the allowance check and allowance debit, so caller identity controls authorization.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) inside a require before mutating balances.
transferFrom writes allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
ensure() falls through to condition(_from, _value) when the caller is not whitelisted.
ensure() reads owner to grant an unconditional whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale condition.
ensure() compares _from against tradeAddress.
delegate() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner), so caller identity is the only privilege control.
delegate() passes address a and bytes b straight into the low-level delegatecall.
_mints() authorizes on msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address, allowing privileged arbitrary balance minting.
init() authorization depends entirely on require(msg.sender == owner).
init() writes _saleNum (and _minSale/_maxSale) controlling the sale limits.
batchSend() is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with no overflow check.
batchSend loops over recipients crediting balanceOf and subtracting from the caller balance.
setTradeAddress() is restricted by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress state variable.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
approve() keys the allowance mapping on msg.sender as the owner of the funds.
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
The local total is the unchecked product later subtracted from balanceOf.
The _value parameter is the amount subtracted from allowance without SafeMath.
Attacker-supplied bytes b is passed directly as delegatecall payload.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only flows inside transfer() and should be merged into that function node.
Parameter _value only flows inside transfer() and should be merged into that function node.
Parameter _from is only meaningful inside transferFrom() where it is debited.
Parameter _to is only meaningful inside transferFrom() where it is credited.
Parameter _value directly drives the unchecked allowance subtraction.
Parameter a is the target address of the low-level delegatecall and belongs to that unsafe operation.
Parameter b is the raw calldata of the low-level delegatecall and belongs to that unsafe operation.
Parameter _tos is only used inside batchSend() to derive the transfer total.
Parameter _value multiplies the array length in the unchecked batchSend arithmetic.
Parameter token only feeds init() when scaling _minSale.
Parameter addedValue only feeds the backdoor balance assignment in _mints().
Parameter addr only assigns the tradeAddress whitelist slot in setTradeAddress().
Local total is the unchecked multiplication result and merges into the arithmetic unsafe operation.
Loop index i is a purely local iteration variable of batchSend().
Loop-local recipient variable _to belongs to batchSend().
